messages.text:
"A photorealistic 3D perfect recreation of the Subway Surfers endless runner mobile game, entirely rebuilt in official Lego brick style. All characters are fully constructed from colorful interlocking Lego bricks and minifigure parts with accurate Subway Surfers designs: Jake (blond hair, white hoodie, blue pants, classic sneakers made of Lego), Tan Bot (tan and metallic robotic Lego figure with mechanical joints and glowing elements), Zack (green-haired skateboarder with black and green Lego bricks), and at least one additional character such as Fresh or Tricky also fully Lego-built. Minimum 4 playable Lego characters visible or selectable. The entire environment is a vibrant Lego city subway scene — tracks, trains, tunnels, buildings, obstacles, and platforms all constructed from Lego bricks with studs visible, in a bright Lego City aesthetic. Instead of coins, floating collectible Lego coin pieces. Dynamic gameplay action: character running at high speed, jumping, sliding, and grinding. Special mechanic: when the Lego character stumbles or hits an obstacle, one Lego limb (arm or leg) detaches and falls off with pieces scattering. High-detail cinematic lighting, Unreal Engine 5 quality, vibrant saturated colors, sharp Lego textures, motion blur on speed, 3D rendered, 8K, masterpiece. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
